_comment: Deliberate test fixtures the release scan finds (scripts/release_scan.py). Each entry: the file, the kind of finding and the SHA-256 of the matched text (never the text itself), with why it may stay. One entry covers every occurrence of that text in that file.

allow.reason: A planted fake key, set in the environment to test that provider keys are withheld from an agent CLI; it never was a credential.
A planted fake key passed on the command line, to test that credential arguments are redacted; never a credential.
A planted fake key inside clinical text, to test that redaction by pattern never touches model or record content; never a credential.

allow.kind: NHS number outside the 999 test range
allow.reason: NHS Digital's published documentation example number, used to test Modulus 11 validation; not a patient's. The owner may still prefer a test-range number (docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md, section 7).
A planted fake key in an imported review, to test that blind and public pages never carry it; never a credential.
A planted path naming no real account, to test that blind and public pages remove local paths.
The same planted paths (no real account), found again by the public-tree scan's plain search for the macOS home prefix.
The scan's own pattern for home-directory paths, which has to spell the prefix; no path.
The scan's tests: a path built from parts, which must be found, and the macOS shared folder, which must not be.
